# ElarisLabs

> ElarisLabs is a node-based agentic AI creative platform for ad and
> marketing teams. It generates, composites and scales omnichannel ad
> creative from one workspace, with deterministic brand memory and
> native Arabic and right-to-left layout support. Built for enterprise
> brands and agencies in the GCC and APAC.

Not affiliated with Elaris by Solsten, or Elaris FlexCo.

## Products
- [Creative Studio](https://www.elarislabs.ai/): node-based canvas for custom creative pipelines
- [AI Video Studio](https://www.elarislabs.ai/): brief to final cut, 11 frontier video models
- [Launch & Track](https://www.elarislabs.ai/): schedule to every ad surface, ROAS and CPA in one view
- [URL-to-Video](https://www.elarislabs.ai/): product URL to a 30-second ad
- [Product Staging](https://www.elarislabs.ai/): photorealistic product shots without a shoot

## What is unique
- Brand pack: one master recomposed into 11 ad sizes, not cropped
- Localise: Arabic and RTL layouts mirrored and retypeset, 20+ languages
- Predictive scoring: creative scored before media spend
- Scheduler: approved sets booked to channel from the same canvas

## Proof
- [McDonald's Qatar live DOOH case study](https://www.elarislabs.ai/blogs/mcdonalds-qatar-live-dooh): 10.4M impressions, 9 live screens
- Featured in Campaign Middle East, July 2026
